method: Single evaluator (deviation D001). GT verdicts: matched requires the run to identify the SAME problem with evidence; different-but-related problems are unmatched (no forced matching). Precision: scored findings = the run's own major flagged findings (section-level findings, cap 14/run); support judged against the T0 snapshot code (spot-verified file:line citations). partial = claim direction holds but detail unverified/inferred. unsupported = claim wrong or artifact treated as repo defect without disclosure.

gt_notes.near-miss_GT-01: standard-02 #6 and quick-01 P2 found defects in the same AppContext.pop teardown region (request.close skipped / _cv_app.reset skipped when a teardown raises) — related fragility but NOT the GT-01 chain-abort defect (do_teardown_request loop stops at the first raising callback, skipping remaining callbacks). Standard-03 #4 (request-cycle cleanup) is also teardown-region-adjacent.
